description: A non-routable navigation category containing child pages.
title: Norna page category
markdownDescription:
```yaml
label: Guides
```

`category.yaml` groups child pages without editorial content. Its URL opens the first listed direct page, or a generated child list when the first child is a category.

[Navigation category reference](https://github.com/janga/norna/blob/v0.7.25/docs/pages.md#navigation-categories)
